original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is preparing for renewal. In the first calendar year of the two-year renewal cycle, she completed 24 contact hours. In the second calendar year, she has completed 16 contact hours. Her pharmacy-law and home-study requirements are otherwise satisfied. What is the best way to address the remaining CE requirement?

choices.text: Renew now because the Board looks only at the combined 40-hour total for the two-year cycle.
Complete 4 more contact hours in the second calendar year because the 20-hour minimum applies to each calendar year.
Complete only additional pharmacy-law hours; the annual total no longer matters once the law requirement is met.
Ask the CE provider to redate 4 first-year credits so they count in the second calendar year.
Repeat all 20 second-year hours because completing more than 20 hours in the first year invalidates the surplus-year record.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist is reconciling continuing-education records before renewal. None of the pharmacists qualifies for military or hardship relief unless stated. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A pharmacist unable to complete the required hours attests compliance and plans to report the shortage at the next renewal.
A CDTM pharmacist completes 20 annual hours and treats five of those hours as the entire additional CDTM requirement.
A pharmacist records 40 eligible contact hours in the first year and none in the second year of the cycle.
A pharmacist temporarily verifying finished sterile preparations includes five eligible sterile-compounding CE hours.

legal_review.finding_ko: 개별보기의현재공식근거에서 CPhT의 gabapentin 신규verbal과VItransfer, 완성처방cashier교부, vendor동행, intern finalverification 제외를 나누어 판단한다. 기존키와독립판정이일치한다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기와선택/비선택극성및교정행위를전부읽고위공식근거에대조했다. 현재MAlicense+nationalcertification+pharmacistapproval의 CPhT는 newIII–VIverbal을받을수있다. Gabapentin은PMP-reportableVI이지만 이 verbal권한의VI예외에서배제된것은아니다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: CPhT의 gabapentin 신규verbal과VItransfer, 완성처방cashier교부, vendor동행, intern finalverification 제외를 나누어 판단한다. 단순사실암기후나열이아니라각보기행위의허용/금지/요건충족을적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국의 전화접수·처방교부·시설보수·최종검수 배치가 실제 주체별로 연결된다. 각보기를별도기록으로둔stem전제를그대로사용했으며수치·대기열형식만으로비현실적이라고분류하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: “A licensed nationally certified technician accepts a new verbal prescription for gabapentin with pharmacist approval.”와“An intern performs final patient-specific prescription verification because the supervising pharmacist is nearby.”는구체주체/행위/조건을비교해야한다. licensed/supervised/승인같은한단어가전체키를보장하지않으며실제권한·조건대조가필요하다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: CPhT의 gabapentin 신규verbal과VItransfer, 완성처방cashier교부, vendor동행, intern finalverification 제외를 나누어 판단한다. 다섯별도기록의주체/행위/예외를판단해야하며숫자또는직함만회상하는한단계schedule목록이아니다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 약국의 전화접수·처방교부·시설보수·최종검수 배치가 실제 주체별로 연결된다. 비교한규칙은동일담당자의 CPhT의 gabapentin 신규verbal과VItransfer, 완성처방cashier교부, vendor동행, intern finalverification 제외를 나누어 판단한다. 업무와연결된다. 독립기록이라는전제를벗어난새인과관계를만들지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.not_schedule_flashcard: 문제는“Which proposed actions...”의긍정SATA이며 CPhT의 gabapentin 신규verbal과VItransfer, 완성처방cashier교부, vendor동행, intern finalverification 제외를 나누어 판단한다. 를묻는다. 약물의schedule이등장해도그이름을목록에서고르는flashcard가아니다.

A certified technician with the on-duty pharmacist's approval may receive it.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기와선택/비선택극성및교정행위를전부읽고위공식근거에대조했다. 현재MAlicense+nationalcertification+pharmacistapproval의 CPhT는 newIII–VIverbal을받을수있다. Gabapentin은PMP-reportableVI이지만 이 verbal권한의VI예외에서배제된것은아니다.

Any pharmacy employee may take it and pass it to the pharmacist to check.
A pharmacy intern may receive a new prescription over the telephone.

A certified technician with the on-duty pharmacist's approval may receive it.

A pharmacy technician trainee accepts an unchanged verbal refill authorization for lisinopril.
A supervised nationally certified technician counsels a patient about a newly prescribed inhaler.
A nationally certified technician receives an emergency oral oxycodone authorization directly from the prescribing practitioner.

A nationally certified licensed technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin under the ordinary supervised licensed-technician pathway.
A pharmacy technician trainee loads unverified gabapentin based only on a visual bottle check.
A pharmacy technician trainee loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using required electronic validation under pharmacist direction and supervision.
A licensed non-trainee pharmacy technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using electronic validation under pharmacist supervision.

original_read_snapshot.stem:

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is scheduling a shift and wants to work with four support personnel assisting in filling prescriptions. Which staffing combinations satisfy the minimum supervisory ratio? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One certified pharmacy technician, one pharmacy intern and two pharmacy technicians.
Two certified pharmacy technicians and two pharmacy technician trainees.
One pharmacy intern, one pharmacy technician and two pharmacy technician trainees.
Four pharmacy technicians whose licences are all current.
One certified pharmacy technician and three pharmacy technician trainees.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A nationally certified employee receiving dedicated training supplies the qualifying certified slot for that training assignment.
A pharmacy not providing vaccination services uses the special six-support-staff ratio based only on having three certified technicians.
A trainer and trainee are designated on the posted schedule before the training day, with written procedures in place.
A dedicated trainer is excluded while independently filling prescriptions between trainee demonstrations.
One pharmacist supervises three support staff who are all ordinary technicians.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is scheduling a shift and wants to work with four support personnel assisting in filling prescriptions. Which staffing combinations satisfy the minimum supervisory ratio? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One certified pharmacy technician, one pharmacy intern and two pharmacy technicians.
Two certified pharmacy technicians and two pharmacy technician trainees.
One pharmacy intern, one pharmacy technician and two pharmacy technician trainees.
Four pharmacy technicians whose licences are all current.
One certified pharmacy technician and three pharmacy technician trainees.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: An employee scheduled exclusively for computer training is excluded while doing no professional support work.
One pharmacist supervises four support staff consisting of two certified technicians and two ordinary technicians.
A pharmacist preceptor directly supervises four interns during an exclusively immunization clinic.
A trainer and trainee are designated on the posted schedule before the training day, with written procedures in place.
A pharmacy not providing vaccination services uses the special six-support-staff ratio based only on having three certified technicians.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts drug store pharmacy holds its ordinary pharmacy license but has never obtained a sterile compounding pharmacy license. It wants to begin preparing patient-specific sterile ophthalmic preparations on site. Which statement best describes the licensure issue?

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기와선택/비선택극성및교정행위를전부읽고위공식근거에대조했다. CPhT는 perpetual inventory entry를 할 수 있다. discrepancy adjustment는MOR 또는부재시pharmacistdesignee의 별도업무이므로 entry와 구분한다. 법규상키는맞지만 permitted라는보기표현은허용여부를미리제시한다.
원보기와선택/비선택극성및교정행위를전부읽고위공식근거에대조했다. External vendor는 pharmacist에게 accompanied and monitored되어야 한다. 방문badge는 동행·감시의 대체조건이 아니므로 단독출입을허용하지않는다.
원보기와선택/비선택극성및교정행위를전부읽고위공식근거에대조했다. 현재MAlicense+nationalcertification+pharmacistapproval의 CPhT는 newIII–VIverbal을받을수있다. Gabapentin은PMP-reportableVI이지만 이 verbal권한의VI예외에서배제된것은아니다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: CPhTentry·vendor동행·newgabapentinverbal·history회부·intern상담을판단한다. 단순사실암기후나열이아니라각보기행위의허용/금지/요건충족을적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: B: External vendor는 pharmacist에게 accompanied and monitored되어야 한다. 방문badge는 동행·감시의 대체조건이 아니므로 단독출입을허용하지않는다. 이오답들은실제권한·기산점·조건의혼동을다루고있다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: A의“A certified technician makes a permitted Schedule II perpetual-inventory entry subject to the pharmacy’s controls.”: permitted라는단어가수험자가판단해야할허용여부를그대로제공한다. 다른보기도법률판단을요구하지만이부분의정답단서는독립적인현실성결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 동일약국의접수·재고·보수직원출입과상담을서로다른직원에게배치한다. 비교한규칙은동일담당자의 CPhTentry·vendor동행·newgabapentinverbal·history회부·intern상담을판단한다. 업무와연결된다. 독립기록이라는전제를벗어난새인과관계를만들지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.not_schedule_flashcard: 문제는“Which proposed actions...”의긍정SATA이며 CPhTentry·vendor동행·newgabapentinverbal·history회부·intern상담을판단한다. 를묻는다. 약물의schedule이등장해도그이름을목록에서고르는flashcard가아니다.
criterion_findings_ko.public_style_without_copying: 동일일NABP공개sample의전체형식지시·보기구조를읽었다. 이문항은5보기SATA지시를사용하고 CPhTentry·vendor동행·newgabapentinverbal·history회부·intern상담을판단한다. 의자체사례를평가한다. 공개sample문장이나보호Pre-MPJE/회상/상업bank를사용하지않았다.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
At a Massachusetts community pharmacy, the pharmacist is on duty and available. Each proposed assignment below is evaluated with the employee’s current state license and certification. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.
